page.layout: One page of text in a single column: a Hebrew lexicon page with Hebrew headword entries and Latin glosses, with a running head at the top and a page number at the foot. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: Pihel פִּרְחַק & Hiphil הֶרְחִיק Elongavit, Longè amovit vel recessit.
רָחוֹק m. Longinquus; Longè, Procul : plural.
רְחִיקִין m. p. Chal. Procul remoti, Esr.6.6.
רְטַפַּשׁ Pyhal Recreari, Hebraei quidam volunt compositum ex רָטַב Humidum. Recens. & פָּשַׁע Augescere.
רִטַּשׁ Pihel Allidere. Pyhal רֻטַּשׁ Allisi.
רֵיחַ m. Odor.Odoratus. Chald. רֵיחַ נוּר Odor ignis, Dan 3 27.
רִחַיִם m. d. Molæ. Duale est, quia mola confistat duabus partibus, Catullo & Metá; id est, superiore & inferiore lapide.
רִיעַ Hiphil הֵרִיעַ Vociferari : Clangere fracto scil.& inaequabili sono : nam al.

page.notes: Hebrew words in the scan are transcribed as best legible; vowel points are partly uncertain. The page is faded and the lower right of several lines is cut off, so some line endings are uncertain. The page number is printed at the foot as "O 4" and the head as "רח רט רי"; the transcription of the running head and number is approximate.
